title: The Seven Works of the Living Spirit
description: Seven works by which the operative Divine power builds the cosmic order as a redemptive vessel: raising the First Man from the contest as a pearl from the sea; spreading and crucifying the Living Soul in every body (Cross of Light); fixing the substances of death; establishing the ships of light (sun and moon); the Five Sons bearing the Girdle/Zone; the dual disposition of storehouses and watch-places; and the Ambassador's glorious image revealed to lift the structure into the new Aeon.
